A.name: Deep catch-and-shoot
A.desc: Lives beyond the arc — spot-up threes are the diet.

B.name: Pull-up combo guard
B.desc: Creates his own shot off the dribble, deep and in the float game.

D.name: Mid-range artisan
D.desc: The mid-range is home: fades, turnarounds, tough twos.

E.name: Balanced wing
E.desc: A bit of everything — no single shot diet dominates.

F.name: Spot-up stretch big
F.desc: A big who spots up outside; cuts and putbacks inside.

G.name: Floater / drive guard
G.desc: Paint touches — floaters and drives are the meal.

H.name: Post hub
H.desc: The offense runs through the post: hooks and paint touches.

I.name: Rim runner
I.desc: Cuts, lobs and putbacks — lives at the rim.

J.name: Rim attacker
J.desc: Gets to the rim by driving through people.
